maddeler.e:
استقضيا (form X)
# اِسْتَقْضَيَا (istaqḍayā) /is.taq.dˤa.jaː/: third-person masculine dual past active of اِسْتَقْضَى (istaqḍā)
# اُسْتُقْضِيَا (ustuqḍiyā) /us.tuq.dˤi.jaː/: third-person masculine dual past passive of اِسْتَقْضَى (istaqḍā)
# اِسْتَقْضِيَا (istaqḍiyā) /is.taq.dˤi.jaː/: second-person dual imperative of اِسْتَقْضَى (istaqḍā)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
